title: A Curated Conspiracy
description: A priceless museum artifact has gone missing. The police are stumped.

museum-lobby.name: Museum Lobby
museum-lobby.description: The expansive lobby of the city museum. Marble floors echo with every step. The display case where the artifact once sat is empty, surrounded by yellow tape.

interactables.name: Broken Glass
interactables.description: Shattered glass from the display case. It was broken from the outside in.

museum-office.name: Curator's Office
museum-office.description: A cramped, messy office. Papers are strewn everywhere.

interactables.name: Financial Ledger
interactables.description: A book detailing the museum's finances. They are deep in debt.

char-curator.name: Curator Higgins
char-curator.description: The nervous curator of the museum.

node-1.text: Oh, it's terrible! The Golden Falcon is gone! Who could have done this?

options.text: Were there any signs of a break-in?

node-2.text: No alarms were tripped. The security guard was on patrol but saw nothing.

clue-glass.name: Shattered Glass
clue-glass.description: The display was broken. Very standard.

clue-debt.name: Museum Debt
clue-debt.description: The museum was bankrupt. The insurance payout for the artifact would save it.

clue-inside-job.name: No Alarms
clue-inside-job.description: The alarms were bypassed by someone who knew the system.

theory-robbery.name: Standard Robbery
theory-robbery.description: A professional thief broke in and stole the artifact.

theory-insurance.name: Insurance Fraud
theory-insurance.description: The curator staged the robbery to collect insurance money.
